深夜！

李青山率先敲响了王春晓家的大门，王守业披着一身衣裳，上下打量着李青山道：“你又来我们家做什么？”

“上次春晓不是说给我介绍对象吗？”

“到底有没有消息啊！”

“我这一个单身小伙子，天天等的着急，晚上都睡不着觉，你去把她喊出来，我问一问，要是介绍不了的话，就把钱还给我。”

李青山表现出一副不耐烦之色道。

“得得得，你等一会！”

王守业一听到钱的事情，立刻答应了下来，朝着自家闺女的房间走了过去。

王春晓的闺房，是整个家中最小的一个房间，仅仅能够放下一张单人床，连个衣柜都没有，就只能随便找了一个类似于板凳的东西，放在床头，上面垒着衣服之类的，不过穷人家的孩子也没什么衣服，加上冬天穿着的，也就那几件，夏天的裤子就一条，上衣倒是有两件，但也都破破烂烂，打满了补丁。

此刻。

王春晓正坐在床上，双手抱着膝盖，透过土胚墙上的窗户望着外面的明月。

脑海中回忆着那一晚李青山救下自己后，孤男寡女在趟子房内的那一晚，双方呼吸都能清晰感受到，却能够恪守礼节，雨夜依偎取暖的粗犷雄性气息，王春晓的嘴角时不时流露出一抹甜蜜之色，但转而又流露出一抹苦涩。

这么好的男人，怎么就死在了老林子里面？

明明临走之前，还答应了自己，要送自己去农村业余高小班去学习的呢！

想到这里，王春晓双手紧紧抱着膝盖，双手因为太过于用力，骨节泛白都尚未察觉，眼眶之中有泪水流转，枕头上清晰可见已经湿了大片，早已将泪水哭的差不多了，眼眶通红。

王春晓在得知李青山死在老林子后，就被王守业拉回了家，一直躲在房间内，根本不知道外面发生了什么，自然也就不知道李青山的死，只是一个谣言罢了。

“春晓，你出去一下，有人找你！”王守业敲了敲自家闺女的房门，开口道。

“爹，我身子不舒服，不去了！”王春晓神情麻木道。

“你不出去不行啊，李青山那小子说你要是还不给他介绍对象，他就要把钱要回来，咱们家哪里……！”

“嘭！”

王守业还没说完，王春晓的房门便被瞬间推开，直接将门外的王守业撞翻在地上。

“哎呦，闺女啊，怎么这么急急躁躁的，疼死我了！”王守业捂着被撞红的鼻子，还有差点被摔碎的屁股，趔趄着身子从地上爬起来道。

“爹，我出去一趟！”

王春晓说罢，哪里还在乎躺在地上的王守业，一路小跑朝着门外奔去。

皎洁的月光下，王春晓终于见到了自己日思夜想，差点让自己哭干眼泪的男人，原本还能忍得住眼泪，心中委屈瞬间释放开，不受控制的挂满了脸，晶莹泪珠不断滑落。

此刻。

李青山站在门外，便见一道黑影朝着自己冲过来，离的近了才看到是王春晓，阵阵香风刚刚靠近，王春晓便宛若八爪鱼一般直接蹦到了李青山的身上。

“哎……！”

李青山措不及防下，倒是被王春晓这个奶凶的大闺女撞了个满怀，身子忍不住向后退了两步，但好在稳住了身子，紧接着便感觉身子被王春晓死死束缚着。

王春晓的委屈，终于在这一刻得到了释放。

双臂死死搂着，不愿意松开。

“你这是咋了？”李青山有些懵逼的问道。

自己又不是死了？

这是什么意思？突然给自己来这么一下，倒是让李青山有些反应不过来。

王春晓从李青山身上滑落，然后就是仔仔细细端详着眼前的李青山，伸出手抓着李青山的下巴，上下看了好几遍，擦了擦眼泪道：“你真的是李青山？”

“废话，我不是李青山，还能是鬼啊！”

“你这是咋了？”

李青山再次问道。

“呜呜……吓死我了，村里人都说你死了，我还以为你真的死了呢。”

王春晓带着哭腔道。

“哦！”

李青山立刻明白过来，这是被李老屯他们给骗了，望着原本一脸奶凶，此刻却哭哭啼啼的王春晓，李青山心中还是蛮高兴的，开口道：“为了补偿你为我流的眼泪，送你个东西！”

说罢。

李青山将准备好的布拉吉连衣裙递给了王春晓。

“这是？”

王春晓望着衣服上的花色眼前一亮，普通的衣裳可没有这样的花色，当李青山将衣服展开的时候，王春晓顿时张大了嘴巴，脸上满是惊讶和喜悦之色。

好漂亮的裙子。

“今天去了乡里，在供销社看到的，我买了几件，给你带了一件，喜欢吗？”

李青山问道。

“嗯嗯，喜欢！”

“太喜欢了，我还从来没穿过裙子呢！”

王春晓望着李青山递过来的裙子，一双美眸之中满是喜爱之色，除了这件裙子确实漂亮之外，最重要的还是李青山赋予的这套裙子别的价值。

“行了，快回去吧！”李青山道。

“嗯！”

“等明天，我穿给你看看！”

王春晓道。

“好！”

“先走了！”

李青山点了点头，趁着夜色匆忙离开，自己还得去一趟柔雪家中，走到小巷子的位置，将放在角落内的一包衣服拿着，便匆匆赶了过去。

王春晓匆匆回到房间后，便迫不及待将衣裳换上，然后在小镜子面前来回转着身，可惜镜子太小了，看不到自己穿上后的样子，不过可以保证的是，这衣裳的上半身，衬托的十分饱满。

李青山一路小跑到了柔雪院子外。

天已经很黑了。

李青山望着眼前低矮的围墙，一个箭步，便直接跳了过去，不过尽量让自己的动静小上一些。

毕竟，柔雪的家中不仅有她自己，还有草儿。

草儿身上的蛇毒已经得到了缓解，如今正在床上熟睡，柔雪一个人坐在院子里，双目无神的望着打开的房门。

人家说，人死了后，头七就会回家！！

自己是李青山的女人，万一青山的亡魂从老林子里面回来，回的是自己这里呢？

所以，到了晚上，将女儿哄睡后，柔雪便打开了院子的大门，面色苍白，双目无神的望着大门，等着李青山从老林子里面回来。

等到李青山的头七过后。

柔雪就打算带着闺女一起赴黄泉，这日子过的太苦了，要把人活生生压死的。

这些年，柔雪都在咬牙死撑。

一次次的苦难，同村人一次次的欺辱，都没能让柔雪倒下，直到李青山死在了老林子，成了压死柔雪的最后一根稻草。

Late at night!

Li Qingshan knocked on the door of Wang Chunxiao's house first. Wang Shouye, dressed in clothes, looked Li Qingshan up and down and said, "What are you doing at our house again?"

"Didn't Chunxiao say that he would introduce me to someone last time?"

"Is there any news?"

"I am a single young man who waits anxiously every day and can't sleep at night. Go and call her out. I'll ask her. If you can't introduce her, give me back the money."

Li Qingshan showed an impatient look.

"Okay, okay, wait a moment!"

As soon as Wang Shouye heard about the money, he immediately agreed and walked towards his daughter's room.

Wang Chunxiao's boudoir was the smallest room in the house. It could only accommodate a single bed and didn't even have a wardrobe. She could only find something similar to a bench and put it on the bedside, with clothes piled on it. However, children from poor families didn't have much clothes, and they only had a few clothes in winter. There was only one pair of trousers in summer and two tops, but they were all in tatters and full of patches.

now.

Wang Chunxiao was sitting on the bed, holding his knees with his hands, looking at the bright moon outside through the window on the soil wall.

Recalling in his mind that night after Li Qingshan rescued him, that night when a man and a woman were alone in the house, they could clearly feel the breathing of both parties, but they could abide by the etiquette, and the rough male aura of cuddling for warmth on a rainy night, Wang Chunxiao's mouth showed a touch of sweetness from time to time, but then showed a touch of bitterness.

Why did such a good man die in the old forest?

Before leaving obviously, he had promised himself that he would be sent to study in a rural amateur high school class!

Thinking of this, Wang Chunxiao hugged his knees tightly with both hands. His joints were turning white without even realizing it because of too much force. Tears were flowing in his eyes. It was clear that a large area was wet on the pillow. He had already cried so much that his eyes were red.

After Wang Chunxiao learned that Li Qingshan died in Laolinzi, he was dragged back home by Wang Shouye and hid in his room all the time. He had no idea what was happening outside. Naturally, he didn't know that Li Qingshan's death was just a rumor.

"Chunxiao, please go out, someone is looking for you!" Wang Shouye knocked on his daughter's door and said.

"Dad, I don't feel well, so I won't go!" Wang Chunxiao said with a numb expression.

"You can't do it unless you go out. That guy Li Qingshan said that if you don't introduce him to a partner, he will ask for the money back. Where is our house...!"

"Bang!"

Before Wang Shouye finished speaking, Wang Chunxiao's door was pushed open instantly, knocking Wang Shouye outside the door to the ground.

"Oh, my dear, why are you so impatient? It hurts me so much!" Wang Shouye stumbled up from the ground, covering his red nose and almost broken butt.

"Dad, I'm going out!"

After Wang Chunxiao said that, he didn't care about Wang Shouye lying on the ground and ran towards the door.

Under the bright moonlight, Wang Chunxiao finally saw the man whom he had thought about day and night and almost made himself cry dry. He could still hold back his tears, but the grievances in his heart were instantly released, uncontrollably covering his face, and crystal tears kept falling.

now.

Li Qingshan stood outside the door and saw a black shadow rushing towards him. When he got closer, he saw that it was Wang Chunxiao. As soon as the fragrant wind approached, Wang Chunxiao jumped directly onto Li Qingshan like an octopus.

"Hey...!"

Li Qingshan was caught off guard and was bumped into by Wang Chunxiao, a fierce girl. He couldn't help but take two steps back, but fortunately he stabilized his body, and then he felt that his body was tightly restrained by Wang Chunxiao.

Wang Chunxiao's grievance was finally released at this moment.

His arms were tightly wrapped around him, unwilling to let go.

"What's wrong with you?" Li Qingshan asked in confusion.

Isn’t he dead?

What does this mean?Li Qingshan was a little unable to react to this sudden attack on himself.

Wang Chunxiao slipped off Li Qingshan, and then looked at Li Qingshan carefully in front of him, stretched out his hand to grab Li Qingshan's chin, looked up and down several times, wiped his tears and said, "Are you really Li Qingshan?"

"Nonsense, I'm not Li Qingshan, I can still be a ghost!"

"What's wrong with you?"

Li Qingshan asked again.

"Woo... I was scared to death. People in the village said you were dead. I thought you were really dead."

Wang Chunxiao said with a cry.

"Oh!"

Li Qingshan immediately understood that he had been deceived by Li Laotun and the others. Looking at Wang Chunxiao, who had a fierce look on his face but was now crying, Li Qingshan was quite happy in his heart and said: "To compensate for the tears you shed for me, I will give you something!"

Say it.

Li Qingshan handed the prepared Bragi dress to Wang Chunxiao.

"This is it?"

Wang Chunxiao's eyes lit up when he looked at the colors on the clothes. Ordinary clothes did not have such colors. When Li Qingshan unfolded the clothes, Wang Chunxiao suddenly opened his mouth wide, with surprise and joy on his face.

What a beautiful dress.

"I went to the countryside today and saw some at the supply and marketing cooperative. I bought a few and brought you one. Do you like it?"

Li Qingshan asked.

"Yeah, I like it!"

"I love it so much, I've never worn a skirt before!"

Wang Chunxiao looked at the skirt handed over by Li Qingshan, her beautiful eyes full of love. In addition to the beautiful skirt, the most important thing is the other value Li Qingshan gave to this skirt.

"Okay, go back quickly!" Li Qingshan said.

"Yeah!"

"Wait until tomorrow and I'll show you how to wear it!"

Wang Chunxiao said.

"Okay!"

"Let's go first!"

Li Qingshan nodded and left in a hurry under the night. He had to go to Rouxue's house. He walked to the alley, took a bag of clothes in the corner and hurried over.

After Wang Chunxiao hurriedly returned to the room, he couldn't wait to put on his clothes, and then turned back and forth in front of the small mirror. Unfortunately, the mirror was too small and he couldn't see what he looked like after putting it on. However, he could guarantee that the upper body of the clothes was very full.

Li Qingshan trotted all the way to the outside of Rouxue's courtyard.

It was already very dark.

Li Qingshan looked at the low wall in front of him, and jumped over with a quick step, but tried to make his movements as small as possible.

After all, Rouxue not only has herself at home, but also Cao'er.

The snake venom on Cao'er's body has been relieved, and she is now sleeping soundly on the bed. Rouxue is sitting alone in the yard, looking at the open door with blank eyes.

People say that after death, the first seven people will go home!!

She is Li Qingshan's woman. What if Qingshan's soul comes back from the old forest and returns to her?

So, at night, after putting her daughter to sleep, Rouxue opened the door to the yard, looking pale and staring at the door with dull eyes, waiting for Li Qingshan to come back from the old forest.

Wait until after Li Qingshan's first seven.

Rouxue planned to take her daughter to the underworld together. Her life was so miserable that she would crush her to death.

Rouxue has been gritting her teeth these past few years.

Repeated hardships and repeated insults from fellow villagers failed to make Rouxue fall, until Li Qingshan died in the old forest, becoming the last straw for Rouxue.
